The name Kishwar carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kishwar usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
